import copy, hashlib, json, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
source = pathlib.Path('products/sites/sqlite-statement-diagnostic/local')
out = pathlib.Path('products/services/sqlite-repair/original-fixture/director-paired-run.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
script = source / 'diagnose.py'
example = source / 'example-case.json'
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
record = {'scope': 'Original fictional inventory data. Offline execution only.', 'implementation_sha256': sha(script.read_bytes()), 'template_sha256': sha(example.read_bytes()), 'prior_invalid_run': 'TASK-179547876100', 'runs': {}}
template = json.loads(example.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
record['template_field_names'] = sorted(template)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    root = pathlib.Path(directory)
    shutil.copyfile(script, root / 'diagnose.py')
    for label, query in {'first_statement_only': 'SELECT quantity FROM shelf ORDER BY quantity; SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM shelf;', 'corrected': 'SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM shelf;'}.items():
        case = copy.deepcopy(template)
        case.update(case_id='fictional-inventory-' + label, seed_sql='CREATE TABLE shelf(quantity INTEGER NOT NULL); INSERT INTO shelf VALUES (4),(7);', query_sql=query)
        for key in list(case):
            if key.startswith('expected'):
                if isinstance(case[key], list):
                    case[key] = [[11]]
                else:
                    del case[key]
        case_file = root / 'case.json'
        case_file.write_text(json.dumps(case, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        command = [sys.executable, 'diagnose.py', 'case.json']
        run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        try:
            report = json.loads(run.stdout)
        except ValueError:
            report = None
        record['runs'][label] = {'input': case, 'input_sha256': sha(case_file.read_bytes()), 'argv': command, 'exit_code': run.returncode, 'stdout': run.stdout, 'stderr': run.stderr, 'report_status': report.get('status') if isinstance(report, dict) else None}
text = json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
out.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
print(text)
